learning: Iteration 7 showed the 12 mm footprint lifts oval and s-bend finishes without moving the slalom. If the slalom stays at about 0.385 with max_error at 0.062, the next change belongs to the controller (kd or base_speed).
notes: Builder's 0.45 kg mass step on the iteration-7 design. Controller unchanged so the mass effect is isolated. Steering oscillation is reported on every track to check for overshoot.
rationale: Iteration 7 (12 mm footprints, 0.5 kg) is the best raced design at 645.9. Its oval finish is 1.00, s-bend finish 0.85 with steering_oscillation 0.487 (under the 0.55 revert line), and slalom progress 0.385 with max_error at the 0.062 floor. The slalom has not finished in any iteration. Across iterations 3 to 7, the track (0.08 m, iteration 4), reach (+/-0.07 m, iteration 5) and mass (0.6 to 0.5 kg, iteration 6) each moved the slalom only a little, so the Builder's single-variable step to 0.45 kg is the planned next test. I keep the iteration-7 controller unchanged (kp 2.0, ki 0, kd 0.6, base_speed 1.4, proportional weights, last_direction) so that the mass change is read alone. If the slalom does not move, the next lever is kd or base_speed, not geometry. Expected result: slalom progress about 0.40 or more, with s-bend steering_oscillation possibly rising toward 0.55 as yaw inertia falls about 10 percent more. Risk: overshoot on the s-bend.
